title: Abba, Father of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A Babylonian of the first generation of Amoraim. He is mentioned in Shabbat 56b, where Rav said: “There is none greater among penitents [than Yoshiyahu in his generation, and one] in our generation” — and who is it? “Abba, the father of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba; and some say Acha, the brother of Abba, the father of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba,” for the master said: Abba and Acha were brothers.
In Menachot 47b he is mentioned as “the father of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba taught.” His son Rabbi Yirmeyah was Rav’s student-colleague.

notes.text: The supplied dash omits part of Rav’s statement. Brackets mark the Yoshiyahu-and-one-in-our-generation wording supplied from saved Davidson Shabbat 56b. The alternative Abba/Acha readings and the brother relation remain explicit.
